criteria.text: Patient is 18 years of age or older
Confirmed diagnosis of acute bacterial skin and skin structure infection (ABSSSI)
Culture shows an FDA-listed pathogen OR documentation that culture is not feasible
Failed at least two other ABSSSI antibiotics including a fluoroquinolone OR contraindication/intolerance to all other Alaska Medicaid covered ABSSSI antibiotics

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Baxdela (delafloxacin), 450mg tablets. Clinical documentation and culture interpretation require manual review.

Approval requires adult age AND confirmed ABSSSI AND either culture path AND either step path. Denials mirror these requirements; the source denial wording does not override the approval OR alternatives.

FDA-listed pathogens: Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA and MSSA), Staphylococcus haemolyticus, Staphylococcus lugdunensis, Streptococcus agalactiae, Streptococcus anginosus Group (S. anginosus, S. intermedius, S. constellatus), Streptococcus pyogenes, Enterococcus faecalis, Escherichia coli, Enterobacter cloacae, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

Cautions (notes only): tendon rupture, peripheral neuropathy, and central nervous system (CNS) effects. Avoid in patients with known myasthenia gravis. Discontinue at the first sign of rash or other hypersensitivity reaction.
Approval duration (notes only): 14 days. Quantity limit: 28 x 450mg tablets (twice daily dosing). Duration and quantity require manual review; max_units is null.
IV Baxdela should be billed through the medical benefit.
